g.text: Design class diagram (2 of 2) — demand, forecasting and identity components
pseudonymize is a function injected by the composition root
does not import the identity component. WaitingService also
uses NetworkReader (stop and route checks) and EventPublisher
expected is null when there is no usable history
("no forecast is made"). Types written as {…} are
+load(from: string, to: string): {rows: HourlyDemand[], coveredDates: string[]}
+count(stopId: string, date: string, hour: number): number | undefined
+explain(stopId: string, date: string, hour: number, modelId?: string): DemandPrediction & {stopName, model}
+backtest(p: DemandPredictor, s: HourlySeries, o: BacktestOptions): BacktestResult
+login(username: unknown, password: unknown): Promise<{principal, token, expiresAt}>
